newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA TATA ELECTRIC RAISES $300 MLN.
newsitem.headline: INDIA TATA ELECTRIC RAISES $300 MLN.

text.p: India's Tata Electric Companies (TEC) said it has raised $300 million through a Yankee bond issue in the United States.
TEC raised the bonds in two lots of $150 million each, with maturities of 10 and 20 years respectively. The 10-year notes were set at 7.875 percent and 20-year bonds at 8.5 percent.
The bond offering is part of TEC's Euro medium-term note programme of $500 million, the company said in a statement.
TEC comprises three firms: Tata Power Company Ltd, Andhra Valley Power Supply Company Ltd and Tata Hydro Electric Power Supply Company Ltd.
The firms constitute India's largest private power supplier generating, transmitting and distributing power to Bombay, India's commercial capital.
The offering, TEC's first international bond issue, attracted good enquiries.
"The bond offering met with strong investor demand with investor interest in excess of $600 million," TEC said in a statement issued late on Thursday.
It said the bond issue had received a Baa3 rating from Moody's and BB+ rating with positive outlook from Standard & Poor's.
Chase Securities Inc. was the sole bookrunner and lead manager on the deal with Credit Suisse First Boston as the joint lead manager, the statement added.
